outcome: Incidence of developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH)
cohort: 424 children (363 girls, 61 boys) diagnosed with DDH between 2003 and 2012
finding: The study found a higher than expected proportion of DDH among Hispanic children and a lower than expected, but not rare, proportion in children of African ancestry, potentially attributed to the mixing of gene pools and changes in infant carrying practices.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery for 47.2% of children with developmental dysplasia of the hip, while 52.8% were delivered vaginally.
